scope: Planning catalogue for vertical-kit coverage; NOT runtime registry, module installation, pricing or implementation evidence.
limitations: No customer interviews, market-weighted sample or universal-completeness proof.
Some official pages timed out on direct access; official indexed excerpts are labelled.
Vendor product descriptions show advertised workflows, not verified interoperability or Archava support.
KBLI press/dictionary leaf-count discrepancy (1560/1559) is not resolved here; only agreed 22 categories are used.
K30/K33/K35/K40 have taxonomy-level evidence; detailed domain invariants remain design hypotheses.

sources.supports: 22 kategori ekonomi; taxonomy statistik tidak menentukan jumlah kit software.
